actors.name: Chair
actors.private_context: The chair has decided to step down and will announce this at the upcoming annual general meeting. They have not yet identified a successor and are not actively recruiting one.

actors.name: Society members
actors.private_context: The members are aware that the chair is stepping down, but no one has yet expressed interest in standing for the position. Some members may be considering it privately.

shared_context: The Kettlewell allotment society holds an annual general meeting in five weeks, at which nominations for chair will close. The current chair is stepping down, and the position will be vacant unless someone volunteers.

starting_events.description: The chair announces their intention to step down at the upcoming annual general meeting.

resolution: Resolve YES if, before the hard cutoff, the persistent event history shows that at least one society member has formally volunteered to stand for chair (e.g., by submitting a nomination or publicly declaring candidacy). Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
